description: List licensed or Medicare-certified providers in one California city, optionally by category. Use when the user asks what providers exist in a California city. Includes address, phone, beds, year licensed, license number and Medicare overall stars where rated. Covers California only. Read-only public records; no prices, availability or reviews. Agencies are listed by the city of their office.

category.description: assisted-living includes assisted living in CCRCs

city.description: The California city the user is asking about, e.g. "Huntington Beach". Not the user's own location.

name: list_providers
title: List providers in a city
